thread:
tara_finance: FYI Solari Health disputed INV-81234. They say platform fee doubled after the recent renewal amendment. Please check contract and billing rule.

ev an_sales: forwarded their email. They claim we applied a new flat platform fee without a signed schedule.

mina_custsuccess: Customer says they expected the legacy 6% during the 60-day onboarding credit window. billing-bot: Invoice INV-81234 lines: ["Committed GPU: $125,000", "Platform fee: $15,000", "Support (Standard): $3,250"], total_due: $143,250. System shows flat fee USD 15k applied; legacy 6% would be $7,500.

tara_finance: That looks like an overcharge of $7,500. @harry_legal can you confirm if AMND-8099 has an executed Schedule G with the flat value?

harry_legal: Pulling AMND-8099. Amendment signed, but Schedule G page where flat fee should be listed is blank in the signed PDF. No executed flat fee value.

ev an_sales: Sales notes captured a verbal agreement to a flat fee, but no signature. Customer willing to accept legacy percent for this billing if we credit the difference and then sign the schedule for future months.

tara_finance: Action: place INV-81234 on hold, prepare credit memo CM-9977 for $7,500, route for approval (credits > $5k require manager signoff), and request written acknowledgement from customer for corrected invoice.

billing-bot: Provisional CM-9977 created for $7,500. Collection status set to On Hold - Billing Dispute.

mina_custsuccess: I messaged Solari ops; they confirmed they'll sign the schedule after we issue corrected invoice. Asked for corrected invoice within 48 hours.

harry_legal: Confirmed unsigned schedule not binding. Approving credit routing; sales must attach signed Schedule G before next bill cycle.

tara_finance: CM-9977 approved by manager and posted. Issued corrected invoice INV-81234-R1 with platform fee set to $7,500. Marking dispute resolved; leaving note to RevRec about possible revenue deferral if amendment is later backdated.

ev an_sales: I'll get the customer's signature on Schedule G and upload to contract repo. Thanks team.

mina_custsuccess: Solari acknowledged receipt and closed the case on their end. Closing thread.
